# CASEs with `line` `rightful-power`

*Lines of inquiry — A named line of the record's own argument, so that a line can be set aside as a whole and what depends on it can be found. Retracting a line is a status change on its members, never a deletion (ADR-032).*

**Rightful power: restriction, answerability and rights** — what makes power over others' capabilities rightful and keeps it so — when a capability should be restricted and by whom, where legitimacy and adequacy come from, when answerability is owed and to whom, which rights no institution creates or extinguishes, how remedies can be foreclosed before review, and accountability for correction without blame; the argument filed from the exchange "Assess Depp Heard Abuse", carried beside dependence-and-domination and organizational-normativity, which its entries keep (the decision adding this line).

Instead of outside support doing the work, a restriction removes the doing, and the restriction lifts when capacity reaches a reinstatement threshold C_r. With [CLAIM-605](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-605.md)'s parameters (λ = 1, μ = 0.3, τ = 1.5), C_r = 0.6 and a party restricted at C = 0.5: with no route the capacity decays as e^(−μt), so it never reaches C_r and the restriction never lifts, the decay being the evidence that extends it; a recoverability deadline of 1.98 time units, past which even releasing the party by hand no longer restores capacity; a practice route must restore exercise above a critical fraction (ρ ≥ 0.8) and even then cannot ignite a party below threshold, whereas a training route that adds capacity directly ignites from C = 0 once its rate reaches μ·C_r = 0.18. Each of [CLAIM-721](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-721.md)'s three conditions is shown necessary. The modelling choices and the finding are in [CLAIM-950](../../../record/claims.d/CLAIM-950.md). The wording is the assistant's (Claude, in this session); adopting it is the owner's call. | Proposed |
